meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它会先给改动范围补上回归测试锁定行为,再按九个分类清理 AI 生成的代码味道(冗余注释、过度防御、死代码等),最后跑质量门验证,验证不过就回退或直接改回。
howto.when: 当你说「清理」「deslop」「去掉 AI 味」等,或要求清理最近的改动时触发;默认范围是相对 main 的分支 diff,也可以传入一份文件清单。

say.text: 把这次分支改动里的 AI 味清一遍
say.note: 先锁测试再清理,最后跑质量门

say.text: 帮我 deslop src/foo.py 这个文件
say.note: 只处理你给的那份文件清单

say.text: 清掉死代码和多余注释,不要改行为

howto.what_en: It locks behavior with regression tests first, then runs a categorized cleanup of nine AI-generated code-smell categories across branch changes or a given file list, and finishes with quality gates and review; if verification fails it reverts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main; you can also pass an explicit file list.

say_en.text: Clean the AI slop out of my branch changes.
say_en.note: Locks tests first, cleans, then runs quality gates.
Only touches the file list you give it.

say_en.text: Remove dead code and obvious comments, keep behavior.
say_en.note: Behavior is pinned by regression tests first.
